acceptanceCriteria: Each family is reproduced under a recorded load (BASE vs fixed counts) or refuted with counts.
Reproduced families no longer depend on wall-clock under load (injected clock or test seam) without widening product bounds; one mutation per family shows the test still bites.
body: suspected: Observed 2026-10-15 by lanes on PRs #937 (BASE f8a963e38) and #938 (BASE 945867cf), darwin go1.27.2, 12 cores. (1) internal/sessiontest TestSTRV0014RunnerCancelAndBudgetKillGroup and TestSTRV0015BudgetBoundsTheShard fail at BASE and fixed with go test -count=3 at load 42-48 (budgets <=1.6 s). (2) internal/liveverify/mutate (11 tests) and internal/liveverify/session (5 tests) failed run-deadline assertions in a -p 4 focused run at load 50-62. (3) internal/testrunner TestGracefulInterruptLifecycle/uncooperative 'graceful fallback exceeded bound' at load 88-161, passed on rerun. Related but distinct: V1-1433 (TestStaleOnLateArrival), V1-1434 (TestExecuteRetiresEscapedDetachedDescendants), V1-0615 (completed).
title: suspected: sessiontest, liveverify/mutate, liveverify/session and testrunner graceful-interrupt tests fail wall-clock bounds under host load
